title: PrediX
tagline: Prediction market powered by AI analytics and news aggregator with tinder based UI.
description:
PrediX is a consumer-focused prediction market built on the Chiliz ecosystem, designed specifically for sports fans. The platform aggregates real-time sports data and enables users to make predictions instantly, without requiring any KYC or complex onboarding.

PrediX aims to deliver an accessible and intuitive prediction experience for everyday fans. A swipe-based, Tinder-style interface makes interacting with predictions simple and fun, while integrated AI models analyze live sports data and news sources to provide smarter insights.
how_its_made: PrediX's wallet connection and onboarding are handled through RainbowKit, providing a fast and user-friendly login flow. For sports insights, I use AI-driven scrapers and olama models to aggregate news, analyze signals, and generate prediction suggestions. The frontend is developed with Next.js for a smooth, responsive swipe-based interface. All structured data, predictions, insights, and event details are stored and streamed through Supabase.
